dangerous_cpts.main_problem: The strongest localized evidence points to an overly rigid CVP entry under low LVEDVOLUME on a suspicious path. This parameter is activated in failures but never in successes, making it a focused refinement target with limited evidence of collateral disruption.

suspicious_parameters.justification: For LVEDVOLUME=LOW, assigning zero probability to CVP=HIGH is physiologically too absolute and was flagged on the only suspicious path. A small increase would relax this hard exclusion while preserving the dominant expectation that CVP should usually be low when filling volume is low.

overall_summary: Only the CVP CPT is sufficiently supported for inclusion in the refinement search space. Other activated parameters are either on uncertain paths or are substantially shared with successful scenarios, so expanding the search beyond CVP is not well justified.
